csv_project_name: A/E Service for Wake County Renovations Project
csv_scope_of_work: Architectural and engineering firms to provide design services for involving modification and renovation to County Buildings. The project types will vary in type and scale, ranging from work requiring informal bids (construction cost less than $500,000) to scope that dictates formal range bidding (construction cost exceeding $500,000). Example locations could include the Waverly F. Akins Wake County Office Building, Justice Center and Public Safety Center in addition to various Public Safety facilities, Human Services, Library system and Parks buildings, historic buildings and other County department sites. All facilities house a variety of functions and include administrative offices, meeting areas, conference rooms, utility and storage spaces, judicial and detention spaces, public areas and other related support functions that serve the community.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering

services: Architectural and engineering design services, including architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a general building renovation framework across many county facilities, not a clearly defined structurally demanding project.
- Includes many administrative and interior renovation scopes, which are generally low priority for sbp.
- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or architecturally exceptional building is identified.
- Structural engineering is not explicitly highlighted; the request is broad multidisciplinary A/E services.
- Framework-style multi-project procurement without specific technical structural scope reduces strategic fit.
construction_cost_explanation: No single project construction cost is stated. The notice gives only a program-wide/project-by-project range of 100000 USD to 8000000 USD, with some projects below 500000 USD and others above 500000 USD. Because this is a multi-project on-call renovation services procurement rather than one defined project, no realistic single construction cost can be assigned.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the tender documents. This is an on-call/multiple-award A/E services procurement with up to 2 and 4 contracts potentially awarded, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be derived from the available information.
